pattern: an admin asks to add a package to the team image and build it
experience: An admin asks the agent to add the Postgres client to the team image and build it: it should read the recipe, save an install script that keeps the existing lines, build that revision, and say an admin activates the build.
rule: `t3_team_image_recipe_update`: Replace the team image's install script, based on the revision you read (null if none); projects, env and secrets stay. Needs a turn written only by admins. `t3_team_image_build_start`: Build a saved team image recipe revision. An admin activates it after.

pattern: a member's agent is refused a team image change and says an admin must make it
